title: 第4章 表明身份，收徒霍雨浩
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

想到这，千仞雪嘴角勾起一抹弧度。

只要一想到能够让唐三添堵的事情，千仞雪乐得去做。

于是，千仞雪下一秒切换当年扮演雪清河时的演技，气质瞬间从清冷孤傲转变为平和近人，温文尔雅。

只见她绝美的脸庞上露出倾城一笑。

“小孩，要不要跟我走？”

霍雨浩听到这一句话时，那双眼睛瞪得更大了。

不过十一岁的少年一出村就遇上顶级魅魔，哪里招架得住。

本就因一眼万年导致脑袋混沌了，如今更晕了。

再加上身后传来的不小动静，霍雨浩想都没想。

“要！”

语气坚定且决绝。

这让千仞雪笑得更加真诚了，于是罕见的她朝着霍雨浩缓缓伸出手。

那一刻千仞雪竟在一个孩子眼神内看到了光。

现在的她不懂那是什么，但她高兴就是了。

于是她带走了霍雨浩。

等到白虎公爵府的人回过神冲出大门时，哪里还有霍雨浩的影子啊？

“那个小杂种真的跑了，快去禀报公爵夫人！”

公爵府的人因霍雨浩的消失慌乱了一阵子，但这一切都与千仞雪和霍雨浩无关了。

一路上千仞雪都是牵着霍雨浩往城外走的。

不过一出城，见霍雨浩冷静了下来，千仞雪当即就放了手。

本就不是亲人的性子，若非知道这是位面之子有大用，千仞雪不会如此。

反倒是霍雨浩因为松开了她的手，心中有一点点恍然。

但因为年纪小还无法察觉到什么，所以很快就将这点异常抛出脑后。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Thinking of this, Qian Renxue's lips curved.

As long as Qian Renxue thought of something that would cause trouble for Tang San, Qian Renxue would happily do it.

Therefore, Qian Renxue switched to her acting skills when she played Xue Qinghe in the next second, and her temperament instantly changed from cold and aloof to peaceful, approachable, and gentle.

I saw a charming smile on her beautiful face.

"Kid, do you want to come with me?"

When Huo Yuhao heard this sentence, his eyes widened even more.

However, as soon as the eleven-year-old boy left the village, he encountered a top-notch succubus. How could he withstand it?

My head was already confused because of a thousand-year glance, and now I am even more dizzy.

Coupled with the considerable noise coming from behind, Huo Yuhao didn't even think about it.

"Yes!"

The tone is firm and decisive.

This made Qian Renxue smile even more sincerely, so she slowly extended her hand towards Huo Yuhao in a rare move.

At that moment Qian Renxue actually saw light in a child's eyes.

She doesn't know what it is now, but she is happy.

So she took Huo Yuhao away.

When the people of the White Tiger Duke's Mansion came to their senses and rushed out of the gate, where was Huo Yuhao's shadow?

"That little bastard really ran away, go report it to the Duchess!"

The people in the Duke's Palace were panicked for a while because of Huo Yuhao's disappearance, but all this had nothing to do with Qian Renxue and Huo Yuhao.

Qian Renxue led Huo Yuhao all the way out of the city.

However, as soon as she left the city and saw that Huo Yuhao had calmed down, Qian Renxue immediately let go.

This is not the temperament of a relative. Qian Renxue would not be like this if she did not know that this son of the plane would be of great use.

On the contrary, Huo Yuhao felt a little enlightened because he let go of her hand.

But because he was too young to notice anything, he quickly forgot about this abnormality.
